thread:
Maya: Heads-up — big co-sell win! AstraForge just went live in Azure IoT Marketplace with our Redwood-Optimized Edge Model Bundle. 🎉

Jonas: OMG yes. This was the one we'd been chasing since Q4. Any metrics?

Maya: Partner quote in the PR: "reducing inference latency by ~40% and cutting token cost by 28% using Redwood Dedicated's batching + quant profiles." They sent logs.

Priya: Can you drop the case study link + one-pager?

Maya: Link: https://redwood.internal/case-studies/astraforge-azure-iot (internal) — one-pager attached to the partner folder.

Derek: Nice. Do we have a note on certs/KMS for Azure IoT Edge? This is for regulated fleet management.

Maya: Product confirmed — uses Private deployment with customer-managed keys + our VPC connector. Derek, Sean (eng) did config template:

```
az iot edge set-modules --module "redwood-edge" --image redwood/edge:quant-8q
```

Jonas: Sales note — upsell motion: dedicated + 3yr reserved for low latency pilots. Priya, can you run renewal playbook?

Priya: On it. Scheduling customer success kickoff for next Wed. CC @Sean.

Sean: Pinged infra to pre-provision telemetry and scale patterns.

Marketplace Bot: Listing published to Azure IoT Marketplace (id: az-asp-astforge-001) — propagation in 2-4 hours.

Maya: Huge props to partnerships, eng, and product. Shoutout to @Jonas for the intro and @Derek for the perf tuning. :tada:

Jonas: Team lunch when customer signs contract :pizza:

Maya: Will add to the weekly wins thread and prep a short social post. Any objections?

Derek: No objections. Congrats all.

Priya: Adding to renewal tracker: https://redwood.internal/renewals/1767804321-astraforge

Maya: Final — will coordinate case study publish date with customer (tentative next Monday).
